properties.name: auth.rate-limit.max-attempts
properties.description: How many login attempts LoginAttemptLimiter allows per key (IP|email) inside one window before refusing with 429.

properties.name: auth.rate-limit.window-ms
properties.description: The length, in milliseconds, of LoginAttemptLimiter's sliding window: how long a refused key stays capped before it resets.

properties.name: auth.rate-limit.max-entries
properties.description: The cap on distinct keys LoginAttemptLimiter tracks at once, so an attacker cycling through addresses cannot grow the map without bound.
